neighbours.label: the blank line / line break that closes an indented shell command or code example inside prose or a docstring, where text resumes
fire:
Add the repository key first:

    apt-get install curl gnupg

Then update the package index and try again.

To build the docs locally, run:

    pip install sphinx && make html

Tested on: Python 3.10 and Debian 12.

Clone the project and enter the folder:

    git clone https://example.org/tool.git && cd tool

Now open the README file for the next steps.

Start the database in the background:

    systemctl start postgresql

After that, create a user for the application.

You can check the installed version like this:

    node --version

If the number is below 18, upgrade before you continue.

Install the compiler toolchain:

    dnf install gcc make cmake

The build should then finish without warnings.

Create a virtual environment:

    python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate

Remember to activate it in every new shell.

Download the archive and unpack it:

    tar -xzf release.tar.gz

The binaries are placed in the bin folder.

notes: Probes: blank line after an indented install command 0.64 and 0.91; ' #' comment start 0.17-0.26; docstring 'Example:' indent 0.38; plain prose paragraph break 0.10; pure code 0.16. The near misses keep the paragraph break and the instructions and drop only the code line.
